_description: 1-line semantic definition per canonical tag. Used in LLM extraction prompt. Keep short (5-12 words).

definitions.ecstasy: extreme overwhelming joy, euphoric peak experience
definitions.awe: reverent wonder at something vast or sublime
definitions.anticipation: expectation of something coming, suspenseful waiting
definitions.dread: slow ominous fear of something bad coming
definitions.horror: shock at something appalling or grotesque
definitions.bittersweet: viewer feels both sad and happy
definitions.haunting: stays with viewer long after, memorable
definitions.revenge: protagonist seeks payback for wrong done
definitions.redemption: protagonist atones for past sins, seeks salvation
definitions.coming_of_age: young protagonist matures through formative events
definitions.forbidden_love: love that cannot be (social/family barrier, doomed)
definitions.identity_crisis: protagonist grapples with who they truly are
definitions.survival: protagonist must stay alive against odds
definitions.sacrifice: protagonist gives something dear for greater good
definitions.moral_dilemma: no clearly right choice, ethical gray area
definitions.justice_vs_law: what is right conflicts with what is legal
definitions.prophesied_destiny: fate/prophecy drives the plot, fulfillment of foretelling
definitions.heist: elaborate planned theft as central plot
definitions.conspiracy: hidden plot by powerful forces, cover-up
definitions.war_and_peace: war's effect on individuals and society
definitions.generational_conflict: older vs younger generation values clash
definitions.class_struggle: rich vs poor, social class conflict
definitions.addiction_recovery: battle with substance or behavioral addiction
definitions.mental_illness: psychiatric or psychological struggle as core
definitions.rivalry: two parties compete intensely against each other
definitions.escape: breaking out of confinement (literal or metaphor)
definitions.transformation: fundamental change in character or form
definitions.time_travel: movement through time as plot device
definitions.Action: physical action and combat as core
definitions.Crime: crime as central focus, often illegal world
definitions.History: set in real historical period, often based on events
definitions.Music: music or musicians as central focus
definitions.Thriller: tension and suspense as primary mode
definitions.Western: American Old West setting and conventions
definitions.villain_protagonist: morally evil character is the lead
definitions.nostalgic: looks back fondly, sentimental for past
definitions.firearms: prominent gunfights, pistols/rifles/shotguns are central to action
definitions.physical_combat: fistfights, martial arts, hand-to-hand combat (no weapons)
definitions.explosions: bombs, demolitions, large pyrotechnic action set-pieces
definitions.supernatural_combat: magic, energy weapons, sci-fi powers, force-based combat
definitions.graphic_violence: explicit gore, blood, dismemberment shown on-screen
definitions.drug_use: drug use is a central theme or shown extensively
definitions.vampire: vampires/blood-drinking undead are central characters or antagonists
definitions.zombie: zombies/undead hordes are central; outbreak survival narratives
definitions.ghost: ghosts/spirits/hauntings are central, including spectral revenge
definitions.alien_invasion: extraterrestrial threat invading earth or first contact in conflict
definitions.mafia: organized crime families (Italian, Russian, etc.); mob hierarchies, codes of honor
definitions.serial_killer: serial murderer is central, methodical/ritualistic killing pattern
definitions.true_crime: based on real criminal events; documentary-style or dramatized
definitions.martial_arts: martial arts (kung-fu, karate, muay-thai, judo) as central craft, not just action
definitions.espionage: spies, secret agents, intelligence agencies, covert operations
definitions.sports: competitive athletic sport is central plot driver (boxing, football, racing, etc.)
definitions.music_performance: musicians, bands, concerts, music industry are central
definitions.prison_life: set primarily in prison; inmate dynamics, escape, reform
definitions.courtroom_legal: trials, lawyers, courtroom drama as the main stage
definitions.hospital_medical: doctors, hospitals, medical crises as central setting
definitions.military_ops: soldiers on mission (special forces, war ops); not full-scale war drama
definitions.school_university: set primarily in school/college; teachers, students as core
definitions.biopic: biographical film of a real historical or contemporary person
definitions.historical_event: depicts a specific real historical event (battle, disaster, revolution)
definitions.musical: characters break into song and dance as core narrative form
definitions.mockumentary: fictional story shot in documentary style for comedic effect
definitions.found_footage: presented as recovered footage filmed by characters
definitions.anime: Japanese animated style and storytelling tradition
definitions.warm_palette: dominated by warm hues (orange, red, gold, amber); sunsets, golden hour
definitions.cold_palette: dominated by cool hues (blue, teal, steel); winter, night, clinical
definitions.desaturated: low saturation, muted colors, washed-out greys, gritty realism
definitions.neon_noir: saturated neon lights against dark backgrounds, cyberpunk/urban-night look
definitions.naturalistic: natural daylight, realistic colors, no stylized grading
definitions.child: main protagonist is a child (roughly under 12)
definitions.young_adult: main protagonist is a young adult (roughly 20-30)
definitions.adult: main protagonist is an adult in mid-life (roughly 30-50)
definitions.senior: main protagonist is a senior citizen (roughly 65+)
